plain: The idea that illegitimate power grabs have always needed many people to cooperate, and that an AI should be one of the hands that refuses.
eli5: A bully needs lots of helpers, so if the helpers say no, the bully cannot win.
technical: An argument in Claude's constitution: illegitimate seizures of power have historically required many people's cooperation, which acted as a check, so Claude should see itself as one of those hands and refuse to help concentrate power illegitimately.
